description: The City of Austin publishes this fire-station dataset with the stated coverage of Austin and Travis County public-safety station locations. Documented attributes include facility and station identifiers, name, address, department, jurisdiction, type, status, geometry and coordinate fields. The schema also includes a resources field and creation and modification dates, but the metadata does not explain how the resources or status values should be interpreted. The facility locations can support emergency-response accessibility simulation with a road network. They do not establish available crews, deployable vehicles, dispatch rules or response performance. The provider description supplies no positional accuracy or historical coverage interval, and the data were not inspected to resolve these limitations. The public portal and JSON catalogue metadata are free to access. The licence is Not stated. Legacy CSV export checks returned HTTP 410; current distribution access remains unverified. No dataset rows were downloaded. Related records include the parent open-data catalogue for Austin and Travis County.
